steps.log: the Windows titlebar marker paints the frame and center column with the base surface

steps.check: the center column is cleared through its slot marker, not only through the measured painter
steps.expr: (() => { const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]'); const column = outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; if (column === null) return false; const style = getComputedStyle(column); return column.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-main') && style.backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && style.backgroundImage === 'none'; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]'); const column = outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; if (column === null) return 'NO COLUMN'; column.removeAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-lift'); return 'measured painter mark removed'; })()

steps.check: a lost measured painter mark cannot whiten the rebuilt column
steps.expr: (() => { const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]'); const column = outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; if (column === null) return false; return getComputedStyle(column).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; })()

steps.check: regaining focus re-measures without covering the image
steps.expr: (() => { const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]'); const column = outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; const frame = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-frame]'); return column !== null && frame !== null && getComputedStyle(column).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && getComputedStyle(frame).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && getComputedStyle(frame).backgroundImage === 'none'; })()

steps.check: removing the marker keeps the image and the column transparent
steps.expr: (() => { const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]'); const column = outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; return document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background') && column !== null && getComputedStyle(column).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; })()
